Optional rollback/netplay dependency; baseline C1 build does not enable netplay.

native_analyzer.staging: bootstrap overlays .cargo/config.toml and vendor/ into staged recompiler-rs while requiring the closure Cargo.lock to match the immutable framework archive

host_boundary.policy: Rust remains an ordinary host/compiler prerequisite and is provisioned before network tracing; project generation must make no outbound network calls after host setup.

dependency_closure.optional: Lua, netplay/rollback and SDL3 source fallback remain classified separately in docs/SNESRECOMP-ISLAND-SCOPE.md.

build_contract: bootstrap_toolchain.py --offline --tool snesrecomp safely extracts the repository-owned framework archive and overlays the locked analyzer Cargo vendor closure. The ordinary snesref smoke and the canonical generation audit must consume only staged repository-owned project dependencies; optional nested netplay contents remain absent.
